DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.PROFILE_DOC: The settings below belong to this profile. Switch profiles to apply a different set.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.PROFILE_ACTION_DOC: Use applies the chosen profile. Copy and Rename take the new name from the field below. Delete removes the chosen profile; the last one cannot be deleted.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.PROFILE_NAME_DOC: For Copy and Rename. Letters, digits, space, dot, underscore and dash, up to 40 characters.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.PROFILE_MODE_DOC: As set per screen: you choose the turn for each screen below. Follow the panel: the screen is turned by what the kernel reports about the panel's mounting, and the per-screen turn is ignored.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.STATUS_NO_X: The display is not running; screen settings are applied when it starts.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.OUTPUT_DESC: Current mode {{mode}}; the kernel reports the panel as {{panel}}.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.OUTPUT_NO_ROTATION: This display driver offers no rotation; the turn is applied to touch, console and splash only.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.OUTPUT_ENABLED_DOC: Off turns this screen off while the others stay on.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.ORIENTATION_DOC: How the picture is turned on this screen. Right and left are the picture's top edge seen from the front. Mirror flips it as in a mirror.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.PANEL_ORIENTATION_DOC: How the panel is built into the device. The kernel reports {{reported}}. Change this only when the picture is wrong before any turn is applied, as on some handhelds and tablets with a portrait panel mounted sideways.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.MODE_DOC: The mode the screen runs at. Preferred is what the screen asks for.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.FIT_DOC: For screens that cut off the edges or leave black borders: scale and move the picture in software.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.FIT_WIDTH_DOC: 100 fills the screen; 95 leaves a border of 2.5 percent on each side.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.FIT_HEIGHT_DOC: 100 fills the screen; 95 leaves a border of 2.5 percent at top and bottom.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.FIT_MOVE_DOC: Negative values move the other way.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.UNDERSCAN_DOC: This driver scales the picture itself; the border is in pixels. 0 turns it off.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.POSITION_DOC: Where this screen sits in the layout of several screens, in pixels from the top left.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.INPUTS_DESC: Touchscreens follow the turn of their screen. Set an offset here when the touch controller is mounted differently from the panel, so that touching the top left reaches the top left.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.INPUTS_NONE: No touchscreen or pointer is connected.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.INPUT_OFFSET_DOC: Applied on top of the screen's turn. Normal for most devices.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.INPUT_OUTPUT_DOC: The screen this device is glued to, when more than one is connected.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_DESC: The turn of the text console and of the boot logo. Both are read at boot, so a change here takes effect at the next restart. The console has one turn for all screens; mirroring does not apply.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_CONSOLE_DOC: The kernel text console and the shutdown messages.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_SPLASH_DOC: The Volumio logo shown while booting.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_LOADER_GRUB: This player boots through UEFI (GRUB); the boot settings travel in rotation.cfg.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_LOADER_SYSLINUX: This player boots through legacy BIOS (syslinux); the boot settings are written onto the kernel line in /boot/syslinux.cfg and written again after every Volumio update.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_LOADER_NONE: No GRUB or syslinux boot file was found on this player; the console and the boot logo cannot be turned here.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_IN_EFFECT: The current boot carries these settings.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BOOT_NOT_IN_EFFECT: The current boot does not carry these settings yet; restart to apply them.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.SCREENSAVER_DESC: When the screen goes dark, whether it stays on while music plays, the mouse cursor, and the backlight.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.SCREENSAVER_TYPE_DOC: Screen off puts the screen to sleep (DPMS); xscreensaver runs a screensaver program; Never keeps the screen on.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.SCREENSAVER_TIMEOUT_DOC: Idle time before the screensaver starts. 0 keeps the screen on.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.NOT_WHILE_PLAYING_DOC: The screen stays on while music plays and goes dark after the usual time once it stops.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.XSCREENSAVER_SETTINGS: Open xscreensaver settings on the screen
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.XSCREENSAVER_SETTINGS_DOC: Opens the xscreensaver settings window on the player's screen to choose the saver.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.HIDE_CURSOR_DOC: The cursor disappears after three seconds without movement.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BRIGHTNESS_DOC: The backlight where the device has one; otherwise the picture is dimmed in software.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.SCREEN_OFF_DOC: A touch or a key wakes it.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.VIRTUAL_DETECTED: This player runs under {{hypervisor}}. A fixed resolution makes the guest boot with a usable screen instead of the hypervisor's default.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.VIRTUAL_NOT_DETECTED: No hypervisor detected. These settings are for players running in VirtualBox, VMware, QEMU, Hyper-V and the like.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.VIRTUAL_ENABLED_DOC: Writes the resolution into the display server's configuration and the kernel line. Takes effect after a restart of the display or a reboot.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.VIRTUAL_RESOLUTION_DOC: The resolution the guest's screen should have.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BACKUP_DESC: Backups hold all profiles and settings. They are kept under Internal Storage and survive uninstalling the plugin.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BACKUP_ACTION_DOC: Create saves the current settings under the name below. Restore and Delete act on the chosen backup. Reset returns every setting to the defaults; make a backup first.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BACKUP_NAME_DOC: Left empty, the date and time are used.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.BACKUP_SELECTED_DOC: The backup to restore or delete.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.MAINTENANCE_DESC: Re-apply the settings, restart the display, and collect a report for support.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.DEBUG_DOC: Writes every command the plugin runs to the system log.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.APPLY_NOW_DOC: Reads the screens and inputs again and applies the active profile.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.RESTART_KIOSK_DOC: Restarts the display server and the browser. The screen goes dark for a few seconds.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.DIAGNOSTICS_DOC: What the plugin sees and what it did, to /tmp/volumio-display-diagnostics.txt.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.APPLIED_REBOOT: Settings applied. The console and the boot logo change at the next restart.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.ERR_PROFILE_NAME: Give the new profile a name: letters, digits, space, dot, underscore or dash.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.ERR_PROFILE_LAST: The last profile cannot be deleted.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.RESET_DONE: Settings reset to the defaults and applied.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.KIOSK_RESTART_FAILED: The display could not be restarted: {{text}}
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED: The report could not be written: {{text}}
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.SCREEN_OFF_DONE: Screen off. Touch it or press a key to wake it.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.XSCREENSAVER_OPENED: The xscreensaver settings are open on the player's screen.
DISPLAY_CONFIGURATION.XSCREENSAVER_MISSING: xscreensaver is not installed on this player.
